richiami.difetto: A possible fault has been identified in the design of the recliner bar of this seat. This could affect the security of the occupant in sudden stop or accident applications.
richiami.modello: SOVEREIGN CHILD SEAT , SOVEREIGN CHILD SEAT
richiami.rimedio: Through contact with stockists and advertising in the Press recall all seats possibly affected by this concern. Where a seat with a faulty recliner bar is identified the seat unit will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: CHILD CAR SEAT DEFECTIVE RECLINER BAR
